note: Recast from Rocha & Cancello (2009), original in English; the original records the alate as Unknown; it also notes that the two elevations on the dorsum of the head vary among individuals of the same colony, a point not treated here as a character.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier has type-2 mandibles and differs from the other species with this type in the denser layer of short hairs over the whole surface of the head capsule. Very close to O. heberi, with the two elevations on the dorsum of the head varying among individuals of the same nest.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Sides of the head parallel in dorsal view. Dorsal tubercle slightly prominent in lateral view, situated behind the lateral projection. Mandibles type 2, with a tooth-like process at the middle. Surface of the head capsule covered with a dense layer of short hairs. Postmentum with setae and sparse short hairs. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum with setae, short hairs scattered over the surface; posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum with setae; abdominal tergites and sternites densely setose, with some erect setae on the posterior margin.
